summary.text: Sandy Crawford, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 28 (Benton, Cedar, Dallas, Henry, Hickory, Pettis, Polk, St. Clair and Vernon counties); she was elected in August 2017.
She is Majority Caucus Secretary and chairs the Senate Insurance and Banking Committee.

paragraphs.text: Crawford is a lifelong Dallas County resident and a 1975 graduate of Buffalo High School.
She received a B.S. in Finance from Missouri State University in 1995 and graduated from the Graduate School of Banking at Colorado in 1998.
She had a 30-year banking career at O'Bannon Bank in Buffalo before serving in the Missouri House from 2010 to 2017.
She chairs the Select Committee on Property Taxes and the State Tax Commission.
Crawford is a member of Tabernacle Baptist Church in Lebanon, and she and her husband, John, raise beef cattle near Buffalo.
